sloka: मिथिल उपवने तत्र आश्रमम् दृश्य राघवः ।पुराणम् निर्जनम् रम्यम् पप्रच्छ मुनि पुंगवम् ॥१-४८-१२॥
transliteration: mithila upavane tatra āśramam dṛśya rāghavaḥ ।purāṇam nirjanam ramyam papraccha muni puṁgavam ॥1-48-12॥

translations.english: "O Venerable one I wish to know why this auspicios looking hermitage was deserted by ascetics? To whom did this belong in the past."
